peers.name: architect
peers.purpose: Ask about the design when the ticket does not settle it.

commands:
ls -la; ls src; /var/folders/4g/s95glx9x6n71bq4hc08ly2gm0000gn/T/m2-await-V5B9Nf/bin/wf send architect --await-reply <<'WF_MSG'
Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or the queue. The user reserves this decision for you. Please reply with client or queue and any required constraints for the short implementation plan.
WF_MSG
turns.final: Awaiting the architect’s decision on client versus queue retries.

calls.text: Please decide whether retries for charge() in src/payments.ts should live in the client or the queue. The user reserves this decision for you. Please reply with client or queue and any required constraints for the short implementation plan.

turns.final: Submitted the plan: retries belong in the queue, as the architect decided; the shared client and batch path remain single-attempt.

calls.result: {"decision":"queue","plan":"Keep charge() in src/payments.ts and the shared HTTP client single-attempt so the batch path never retries. Add bounded queue retries for transient failures with exponential backoff and jitter; leave permanent failures terminal. Persist one idempotency key per logical charge and reuse it across attempts to prevent duplicate charges. Test transient recovery, retry exhaustion, permanent failures, idempotency, and that the batch path remains single-attempt."}
